sections.title: Reliable Movers in Encino, CA
sections.content: Ventura Boulevard splits Encino into two kinds of moves: a regular street grid of ranch homes and courtyard apartment buildings to the north, and hillside streets climbing toward Mulholland to the south. Tell us which side you're on, and we'll plan the truck spot, the carry and the crew before moving day. What you can check before you book: Licensed and insured: CPUC licensed under CAL-T0192140, registered with USDOT 3398018 and MC 1153871, and backed by full liability coverage and workers' compensation. Public reviews: Rated 4.9 on Google from 1,007 reviews. Posted rates: From $119/hr for 2 movers and a truck on Monday–Thursday (cash rate) and $135/hr Friday–Sunday. Comparing Encino moving companies? Start with the CPUC number and the reviews, then call 909-443-0004 or request a free estimate.

sections.title: Packing for Larger Encino Homes
sections.content: Estate homes in Royal Oaks and Clark Gable Estates can include guest houses and collector garages, so there is more to pack than the main floor plan suggests. For Encino homes, our moving services include packing for the whole property, with every box labeled by room. How we pack an Encino house: Fragile rooms first: Kitchens, china cabinets and display shelves are wrapped piece by piece and boxed before any furniture moves. Art and antiques: Paintings, sculptures and heirlooms can go with our white glove movers for extra protection in transit. Guest house, garage: Secondary buildings are packed and labeled as their own zones, so guest-house boxes go back to the guest house. Pack the everyday rooms yourself and leave the breakables to us, or book the whole house.

sections.title: Moving Around Encino and the Valley
sections.content: Whether a local move takes you east to Sherman Oaks, west to Tarzana or across the Sepulveda Basin to Van Nuys, the hourly rate covers it, and our long-distance movers take over when the destination is out of state. If the route crosses the Ventura and San Diego freeway interchange near Sherman Oaks, where rush-hour backups are routine, we'll plan the start time around rush hour. What the hourly rate covers: Stairs and carries: Multi-level hillside houses and long gated driveways add time on the clock, not stair or long-carry fees. Extra stops: Dropping a few pieces at a storage unit or a second address on the way is included, not billed as an add-on. Materials and setup: Blankets, shrink wrap, tape and wardrobe boxes come on the truck, and the crew handles furniture disassembly and reassembly, TV unmounting, placement and unpacking help. Need local movers in Encino this week or a long-distance crew next month? Call 909-443-0004; same-day moves are possible when a crew is free.

sections.title: Long-Distance Moves Out of Encino
sections.content: Redfin's migration data ranks Las Vegas as the top out-of-state destination for Los Angeles house hunters and San Diego as the top in-state one. We plan both trips from Encino, along with moves across the country. Routes we plan from Encino: San Diego: Staying in California but leaving the Valley? We pack in Encino and unload at your new address down the coast. Las Vegas: Crossing into Nevada makes it an interstate move, handled under our USDOT 3398018 and MC 1153871 registrations. Cross-country: For moves farther east, we can hold furniture in storage until the new place is ready. Weighing a long-distance move against staying in the Valley? We can price both options: the out-of-state move and a local move around Los Angeles.

sections.title: Office Moves on Ventura Boulevard
sections.content: Relocating an office or practice along Ventura Boulevard, Encino's business district? Our commercial movers pack the files, move desks and equipment, and place everything in the new suite.

faq.question: What is added on top of the hourly rate for an Encino move?
faq.answer: Our rate starts at $119/hr for 2 movers and a truck on Monday–Thursday (cash rate) and $135/hr Friday–Sunday, plus a $30 gas fee, and the $50 deposit is applied toward your total. Stairs, long carries and multiple stops are included, while a piano is $200 and items heavier than 300 lbs are $150. Under CPUC rules, Double Drive Time applies to longer local moves, and long-distance moves are priced through a free estimate.

faq.question: Do you move homes in the hills south of Ventura Boulevard?
faq.answer: Yes. Streets in the Encino Hills wind toward Mulholland and narrow in places, and plenty of homes sit behind gates or at the end of long driveways, so we ask about truck parking and the walk to the door when you book. Stairs and long carries are part of the hourly rate, so a multi-level house or a long driveway adds time, not a surcharge.

faq.question: Can you move us in or out of a guard-gated community in Encino?
faq.answer: Yes. Encino has guard-gated enclaves such as Royal Oaks Colony and Park Encino Towers, just south of Ventura Boulevard. Send us the gate instructions and any HOA move rules when you book, and we'll schedule the crew's arrival around them.

faq.question: Do you move between Encino and Sherman Oaks, Tarzana or Van Nuys?
faq.answer: Yes. Sherman Oaks borders Encino to the east and Tarzana to the west, with Ventura Boulevard running through all three, and Van Nuys sits across the Sepulveda Basin. Those moves run at our standard hourly rate, and dropping items at a second address on the way is included.
